subject: Promo code allocation for Ignite: attendee trials & speaker reserve
messages:
From: Sally Park <sally@ignitelabs.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Promo codes for June Ignite demo — 100 attendee requests

Hi Mina,

Hope you’re well — we’re finalizing the attendee perks for Ignite Labs’ June 10th demo day and would love to offer event attendees a short trial of Redwood to drive follow-ups. Our ask: 100 promo codes that grant a 30-day trial + $150 in credits. We typically split codes between attendees (80) and speaker/mentor reserves (20).

Can Redwood support that allocation? Also need to confirm:
- Whether codes can be redeemed in our CloudMarket flow (we use CloudMarket marketplace)
- Any limits on region or IP (most attendees are NA, a small EU group)
- Standard attribution requirements (UTM/partner tags)

I’ve attached a brief event sponsorship request for context. If possible, can we get a draft of the promo agreement and mechanics by Monday so we can include the offer in the event page?

Thanks — excited to promote Redwood at Ignite.

—
Sally Park
Head of Events, Ignite Labs
events@ignitelabs.io
[Attachment: ignite_promo_request_20260516.pdf (pdf)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sally Park <sally@ignitelabs.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo codes for June Ignite demo — 100 attendee requests

Hi Sally — great to hear from you and congrats on the lineup. We can support promo codes for the event; below is a proposed plan to keep mechanics simple and protect the credit pool.

Proposal (initial):
- Total codes: 100 promo codes
  - 80 attendee codes = 30-day trial + $150 credits
  - 20 speaker/mentor reserve = 30-day trial + $300 credits (speaker uplift)
- Redemption window: Codes valid for 90 days from issue
- Region: Global, but we’ll flag codes issued for EU users so we can adjust data retention defaults (GDPR-friendly)
- CloudMarket: Codes can be redeemed via your CloudMarket listing — we’ll coordinate with CloudMarket Ops to enable promo acceptance.
- Attribution: Use partner_code=ignite2026 as UTM; we will surface this in cost/allocation reporting for the campaign.

Next steps I need from you:
1) Confirm you want the 80/20 split above or request a different reserve (e.g., 70/30)
2) Confirm if any attendees must have pre-registered redemption (we can pre-load codes)
3) Confirm the CloudMarket contact (cc’ing them helps speed integration)

I’m attaching a promo code pool template for your ops team and our draft promo agreement. Marissa — can you pull allocation logistics (rate limits, default quota per redeemed account) and flag anything else we should include? Ben — can you confirm whether the speaker uplift (higher credits) is ok from a finance perspective?

Attachments: promo_code_pool_template.csv; redwood_promo_agreement_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Mina
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai
[Attachments: promo_code_pool_template.csv (csv), redwood_promo_agreement_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo codes for June Ignite demo — 100 attendee requests

Thanks Mina — quick ops notes from my side:

- Rate limits & default quotas: Redeemed accounts will get a soft quota tied to trial tier — 100k tokens/day recommended default for trial accounts; we can change this per request but need a written ask.
- Code pooling: We’ll issue a 100-code batch via our partner portal; codes can be pre-loaded as CSV or generated one-off. Pre-loading is easier for managed events.
- CloudMarket integration: I’ll loop in CloudMarket Ops (can you introduce their contact?) — they need the promo_id and the list of codes.
- Speaker reserve: We recommend holding back 10 codes as on-demand (reserve) and 10 pre-assigned to speakers; the smaller holdback avoids unused inventory.
- Monitoring & reporting: We’ll provide a short dashboard (daily redemptions, top referrers) and a one-week post-event summary.

Operational ask for Ignite: please confirm attendee count and whether you want us to upload codes (preferred) or send you the CSV. Also confirm who at CloudMarket is the integrator so I can grant access to the promo bucket.

Alex — can you prep the partner portal entry and set a 100-code batch with two sub-tags (attendee, speaker-reserve)? I’ll set the default quota and the reporting hooks. Ben — finance sign-off on speaker uplift?

—
Marissa Cole
Partnerships Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: promo_code_pool_template.csv (csv)]

From: Sally Park <sally@ignitelabs.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudMarket Ops <cloudmarket-ops@cloudmarket.example>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo codes for June Ignite demo — 100 attendee requests

Thanks — that all looks good. A couple of quick confirmations: 

On Mon, 16 May 2026 at 11:05, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Proposal (initial):
> - Total codes: 100 promo codes
>   - 80 attendee codes = 30-day trial + $150 credits
>   - 20 speaker/mentor reserve = 30-day trial + $300 credits (speaker uplift)
> - Redemption window: Codes valid for 90 days from issue
> - Region: Global, but we’ll flag codes issued for EU users so we can adjust data retention defaults (GDPR-friendly)
> - CloudMarket: Codes can be redeemed via your CloudMarket listing — we’ll coordinate with CloudMarket Ops to enable promo acceptance.
> - Attribution: Use partner_code=ignite2026 as UTM; we will surface this in cost/allocation reporting for the campaign.

We’ll go with the attendee/speaker split you proposed but would prefer the speaker reserve to be 15 pre-assigned (speakers) + 5 on-demand (organizers) — so 15/5 rather than 10/10. Otherwise the redemption window and credits are perfect.

CloudMarket Ops — can you confirm you received this thread and the CSV? We’d like Redwood to upload the codes to the marketplace and set the partner_code tag so redemption is automatic. If you need a PO or formal agreement signature, we can route through procurement this week.

If we’re aligned I can sign the draft agreement (redwood_promo_agreement_v1.pdf) and return via DocuSign — please send the DocuSign link when ready.

Thanks everyone — excited to highlight Redwood on stage.

—
Sally Park
Head of Events, Ignite Labs
[Attachment: none]
